from collections import Counter
def consensus(inp,bs=4):
    n=inp.shape[0]//bs; res=[]
    for bi in range(n):
        for bj in range(n):
            cells=[inp[bi*bs+i,bj*bs+j] for i in range(bs) for j in range(bs)]
            cells=[c for c in cells if c!=5]
            cnt=Counter(cells)
            mx=max(cnt.values())
            # tie-break by most common first, else last occurrence
            cands=[c for c in cnt if cnt[c]==mx]
            last=max(cands,key=lambda c: len(cells)-1-cells[::-1].index(c))
            res.append(last)
    return np.array(res).reshape(n,n)
pred=consensus(inp)
print(pred.tolist(), pred.tolist()==out.tolist())
